scripts.build: bun run registry:build && bun run --cwd apps/docs build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/registry typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/docs typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/oxlint-plugin typecheck
scripts.test: bun run registry:build && bun test packages/registry/test packages/oxlint-plugin/test apps/docs/test test/release-readiness.test.ts test/xstyle.test.ts test/strict-forms.test.ts test/strict-overlays.test.ts
scripts.test:a11y: bun run build && FULL_A11Y=1 PLAYWRIGHT_PRODUCTION=1 playwright test --project=chromium --grep @full-a11y
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && PLAYWRIGHT_PRODUCTION=1 playwright test
